summary: DevRelay V0.11 is deeply verified and deterministic but exposes too much internal complexity through its root API, evidence-heavy repository, verbose operator surface, and oversized delivery unit. SIM-001 simplifies adoption while preserving all trust boundaries and adds the durable Windows host needed for ChatGPT Desktop use.
stakeholders: Module, adapter, pack, and host authors
domainConstraints: The released lifecycle and Gate ownership remain authoritative.
RequirementsGathering retains adaptive mandatory closure for every profile.
Evidence moved out of Git remains immutable, checksum-bound, and independently retrievable.
The local host enforces explicit capabilities and one exact executor binding.
Stable release requires independent human review.
conventions: Use content-addressed artifacts and immutable versioned policy.
Keep the standard path concise and advanced paths explicit.
Use bounded stacked pull requests with exact parent identities.
Keep preview and stable claims distinct.
Preserve compatibility for one prerelease cycle through compat/v1.
